title: Mid-level API Designer
description: Mid-level API designer capable of independently designing API maturity models, establishing contract testing governance, architecting OAuth2 scope taxonomies, selecting appropriate API protocols with decision frameworks, and managing API deprecation lifecycles.

skills.rationale: Evaluating Richardson Maturity levels, designing query language standards, and architecting bulk/batch operation patterns with partial success handling.
Establishing gRPC contract standards, authoring AsyncAPI event specifications, and applying protocol selection decision frameworks.
Designing OAuth2 contract patterns with appropriate grant types, modeling hierarchical scope taxonomies, and architecting token exchange delegation flows.
Establishing contract testing governance with Pact broker CI integration, designing event-driven API patterns, and facilitating consumer-driven design reviews.
Managing API deprecation with Sunset headers, maintaining API catalog registries, participating in design review boards, and improving developer portal DX.
Architecting multi-layer caching strategies, designing SLA/SLO-driven latency budgets, and governing HTTP/2 connection management policies.
Designing content negotiation strategies with vendor media types, architecting HTTP caching policies, and defining Idempotency-Key contract standards.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in API maturity assessment, contract testing, or multi-protocol governance.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Competent with REST standards, but needs guidance on federation, schema registries, and OAuth2 scope modeling.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong API design capabilities across REST and alternative styles; refining expertise in contract testing governance and deprecation management.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: independently designs multi-protocol APIs with contract testing, OAuth2 scope modeling, and SLA-driven performance standards.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level expectations with advanced API gateway architecture, federation design, and API program management awareness.
